text: Structural steel shall be designed per EN 1993-1-1 and EN 1993-1-8 with seismic detailing per TBDY 2018; fabrication and execution class EXC3 per EN 1090-2 for the power block structures and EXC2 for other structures; steel grades S355J2 for main members and S275JR for secondary members and grating supports; thick plates (t > 30 mm) and seismic energy dissipating members shall be tested for through-thickness properties (Z25) and Charpy J2 at -20 degC; the minimum service temperature is -15 degC (DP-CASE-0009).
